description.value:
Frequency once per day

Compounds that occur naturally within your leaves have healing effects on other creatures, and you're always finding new ways to harness them. You coat an adjacent willing creature's wounds in your own blood. You lose 1 Hit Point for every 2 levels you have. This damage can't be resisted, prevented, or negated in any way. The target creature regains @Damage[1d6[healing]] Hit Points for every Hit Point you lost.
